papers.title: Resonant States in Light Hypernuclei
papers.summary: Energies of strangeness $$S=-1$$ three- and four-body hypernuclei are calculated employing realistic nucleon–nucleon (NN) and hyperon–nucleon (YN) interactions derived from chiral effective field theory. Both bound and resonant state positions are determined, and the impact of the three-nucleon ($$NNN$$) force on these observables is investigated.
